purpose: Builtin generated UNNEST complete-job comparison, including rejected binary ROW cache prototypes.

host_signature_probes.outcome: Stock planning rejected ProjectToCalcRule: IllegalArgumentException Type mismatch, ROW peek_no_expand versus ordinary ROW. Native planner had not been installed.

flink118_source_note: After Flink 1.18 timings, only unsuccessful-admission diagnostic wording changed in the two UNNEST matchers; their pre-wording hashes are recorded separately. Admitted execution paths are unchanged.

configuration.source: row fromSequence/map with nullable strings and nullable/empty arrays
configuration.timed_boundary: executeSql through completion, including planning/deployment/source/expansion/optional state/both transposes/sink; cluster construction and initial explain excluded

implementation_phases.initial: Generated correlate with preserving Arrow inputs/outputs, pruned inputs/projection; nested ROW output uses recursive readers/serializer copies.
implementation_phases.binary_cache: Rejected prototype caching only BinaryRowData; actual MAP ROW values are NestedRowData, so the dominant copy cost remained. Exact Java source snapshot was not retained.
implementation_phases.cache_projection: Caches BinaryRowData and NestedRowData, verified immediate binary exit projection. Later configuration/watermark checks do not affect this benchmark SQL.
implementation_phases.prior: Frozen prior production, identical fixture; zero native substitutions asserted.
implementation_phases.final: Final candidate; generated UNNEST and both transposes asserted; consumed rows asserted, including grouped consumer.
implementation_phases.validation_before: Pre-optimization wider fixtures; the 128-byte updating string MAP is slower than stock. All measurements retained.
implementation_phases.validation_bulk: Bulk UTF-16 copies alone improved the updating 128-byte string MAP, but still lost to stock; all trials retained.
implementation_phases.validation_lazy: Unbounded scratch and lazy sidecars: wide-string median slightly beats stock with overlapping ranges. Retained before bounding scratch to 8KiB.
implementation_phases.validation: Final candidate with larger sources, wider payloads/expansions, changed input cardinality and all four source RowKinds.
implementation_phases.prior_validation: Frozen prior production with the corresponding validation fixture and zero native substitutions.
implementation_phases.before118: UTF-16 bulk copies and lazy sidecars on Flink 1.18.1, before bounding writer scratch to 8KiB; all representative candidate widths are below the bound.
implementation_phases.final118: Final candidate on released Flink 1.18.1, identical production code and benchmark fixture, separately compiled compatibility sources.
implementation_phases.prior118: Frozen prior production on released Flink 1.18.1, identical fixture; zero native substitutions asserted.

notes: Startup remains included; these are complete-job medians, not guaranteed sustained-throughput gains.
Prior controls run in separate JVMs; their paired stock trials expose drift.
Every initial and intermediate losing measurement is retained.
CPU-profile durations are diagnostic and excluded from these comparisons.
The initial ROW output loss motivated the owned payload and verified exit optimization; the first payload-only attempt also lost.

flink_1_18_1.note: Two broad-run unit expectations were corrected to match Arrow ListVector allocation-error wrapping; the targeted eight-unit rerun passed. Two added ARRAY_APPEND ROW-chain cases are absent from this host catalog and were observed skipped.

validation.recovery: Generated MAP COUNT/SUM: two successive restores on each of memory and native RocksDB, consumed operators and released memory asserted.
